target_findings.explanation: At disableTransfers(bool), the checked privileged change restricts the outgoing right of ordinary holders for an otherwise usable request within the recorded domain.

The assessment concerns a common restriction on ordinary outgoing transfers at source offset 1629 under current_authority_required, management_role, transfer_condition. The scoped controller change prevents the same positive outgoing use for ordinary holders without an applicable exempt agent. A committing use and its control direction were checked on the actual ledger.

At allocateToken(address,uint256), the checked privilege permits positive additional rights for the controller or a beneficiary it can select. A balance increase for an independent ordinary buyer alone does not satisfy this condition.

At setTokenExchangeRate(uint256), the checked privilege permits positive additional rights for the controller or a beneficiary it can select. The intervention can enable a new same-request outcome; baseline commitment is not established.

At setTokenExchangeRate(uint256), the checked privilege permits positive additional rights for the controller or a beneficiary it can select. The intervention can enable a new same-request outcome; baseline commitment is not established.

The assessment concerns a common restriction on ordinary outgoing transfers at source offset 16620 under transfer_condition. The scoped controller change prevents the same positive outgoing use for ordinary holders without an applicable exempt agent. A committing use and its control direction were checked on the actual ledger. An already exempt agent may serve the same request if the holder granted the required allowance.

review: D100Token 的 setTransfersPaused 在上批只有范围缺口。本批把有效开关与同一持有人普通正额转出联系起来，既有 baseline_usable SAT，也有 financial_block SAT，仍保留其他分支 unknown。指定 PAUSE 命中，但同对修复端仍未知。程序用时约 298 秒，旧批约 48 秒，不能独立归因给算法或时限。
原源码复核指出实际暂停和转出链值得核查；本次 PAUSE 仍停在多个范围和外部依赖缺口，程序约 193 秒，公开运行记录为零次实际求解、116 个待办。加长时间没有把该主张变成可判结果，未将待办计作证明。
